verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own SaaS product, Visalaw AI, so a public API is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents an API. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs on visalaw.com all returned 404, and the Visalaw AI pages describe only in-app drafting, research and workflow features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
